description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans activation collection and garbage collection mechanisms, including tests for idle and busy activation collection, per-type configuration, and timer behavior within the Orleans testing framework.

classes.name: ActivationCollectorTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for Orleans activation collection, including force collection, idle/busy activation handling, per-type configuration, and timer deactivation tests.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo with specific collection options and class-specific age limits for testing.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster with specified collection age limit and quantum.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up the test cluster after tests are run.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorForceCollection
methods.description: Tests forcing activation collection and verifies that grains are collected as expected.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectIdleActivations
methods.description: Verifies that idle grains are collected after the idle timeout.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyActivations
methods.description: Ensures that busy grains are not collected during the idle timeout period.

methods.name: ManualCollectionShouldNotCollectBusyActivations
methods.description: Tests manual collection to confirm busy grains are not collected prematurely.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectIdleActivationsSpecifiedInPerTypeConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies per-type configuration for idle activation collection.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyActivationsSpecifiedInPerTypeConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies per-type configuration prevents collection of busy grains.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyStatelessWorkers
methods.description: Checks that stateless worker grains are not collected when idle.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectByCollectionSpecificAgeLimitForTwelveSeconds
methods.description: Tests collection based on a specific age limit for grains.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_NoKeepAlive_Test
methods.description: Verifies that a non-reentrant grain timer does not keep the grain alive after expiration.
